title: The guard applies a role's file scope to Bash writes too (cp, mv, tee, redirect)
why: On #2015's mixed merge a test-author wrote 5 product files with cp, so the guard's file-edit refusal for that role never fired.
note: Coordinator 14:07 CST Nov 10. Home: the role file-scope guard (decision builders-cannot-edit-tests). Red cases first: a test-author's cp, mv, tee and > redirect onto a product file are refused; the same onto a test file is allowed; a builder's Bash write onto a test file is refused.
